articles.title: JPMorgan, HSBC and StoneX complete first digital gold trades in London
articles.snippet: The banks tested a new way to trade fractions of physical gold bars and use the metal as collateral without moving it from vaults for the first time.

articles.title: Nvidia's Jensen Huang faces Senate scrutiny despite Trump-backed return as CEO
articles.snippet: Congressional scrutiny will continue even as CEO returns to lead the company after his affair scandal and its national-security implications.

articles.title: Nvidia soars as Jensen Huang returns to lead company
articles.snippet: The Nasdaq gained more than 6% as Nvidia rose as much as 35%. After a brief surge, crypto returned to a more muted advance.

articles.title: Fidelity Investments, Strive, Etoro join OKX-ICE tokenized securities venue
articles.snippet: The Intercontinental Exchange-backed venture said it has confirmed 113 assets for listing as trading begins, following a wave of objections from companies initially picked for inclusion.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin climbs only modestly as Nasdaq soars 6% on Huang return
articles.snippet: Nvidia is higher by 30% after the company board announced the reinstatement of Jensen Huang as president, CEO, and director.
